chunk: _comment: "Canonical model standards registry. Maps vertical + record type to the authoritative industry standard. Agents consult this when creating or validating canonical schemas — never invent field names when a standard exists."

_rules: [
  "vertical is derived from company_context.json industry field — never from client name",
  "standard = 'derived' means no dominant standard exists; use source-system field terminology as reference",
  "When standard is set: canonical field names MUST align with the standard's field naming (note deviations in the YAML)",
  "ediTransactionSet populated only for edi-b2b vertical — the EDI message IS the canonical for those records"
]
